summary_1line: Krishna urges strategic action against Jarasandha and begins recounting the miraculous circumstances of Jarasandha’s birth from King Vrihadratha’s divided fruit.

image_candidates.scene_text: A sage meditating beneath a mango tree receives a perfect fruit falling into his lap and gives it to the hopeful king Vrihadratha.
Two queens each hold half of a newborn body—each fragment with one eye, one arm, and one leg—staring in horror at the unnatural birth.
The king Vrihadratha stands with his two twin queens beneath a mango tree, humbly bowing before the ascetic Chanda-kausika.
